hints.title: Fixed Length Substrings
hints.text: Convert num to string to inspect each contiguous substring of length k.

hints.title: Non-Zero Divisor Condition
hints.text: Parse each substring as an integer. If the integer is non-zero and divides num without remainder, it is valid.

hints.title: Sliding Substring Window
hints.text: Slide the window from index 0 to len(s) - k, counting matches.

hints.title: Sliding Window K-Beauty Implementation

variables: n: number of digits in num
complexity.notes: Digit string conversion and slice parsing takes negligible constant time for 32-bit integers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No complex failure mode; straight window inspection is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space to store digit representation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles zero divisors appropriately without runtime exceptions.
